purpose: non-executable preparation dataset; not a runtime seed

protocols.name: Screening instrument
protocols.limitations: Exact adopted edition, commercial permission, population and clinical policy unverified; no questionnaire text reproduced.

protocols.name: Health history
protocols.limitations: An unchecked/default No is unknown. Separate coach interpretation from client response.

protocols.name: Movement observation
protocols.measurement: item + side + observed state + severity label
protocols.limitations: Legacy NASM-labelled associations and normalized scores are not diagnoses or validated risk scores.

protocols.name: Legacy movement screen
protocols.limitations: No conversion into the newer observation protocol or clearance.

protocols.name: Strength performance
protocols.measurement: variant + kg + reps + technique + effort + date
protocols.limitations: Default one rep is not proof of a tested maximum. Estimated and measured values stay separate.

protocols.name: Range-of-motion assessment
protocols.limitations: Unspecified unit or procedure is unusable for quantitative change; no universal cut-offs.

protocols.name: Endurance assessment
protocols.limitations: Free text may be context only; do not normalize unlike tests.

protocols.name: Pain/functional report
protocols.measurement: body region + side + report + severity scale version + activity
protocols.limitations: New/worsening concern routes to the reviewed policy; default severity is not a report.

protocols.name: Baseline lifestyle
protocols.measurement: sleep h; sleep quality 1–7 good-high; stress 1–7 bad-high; fluids L/day; steps/day
protocols.limitations: HHQ categorical stress/sleep and body-composition water litres are not interchangeable.

protocols.name: Goals and preferences
protocols.measurement: coach-confirmed priority; target metric/unit/date; explicit inventory
protocols.limitations: No inferred target order, equipment quantity, hard refusal or assistant availability.

protocols.name: Body composition
protocols.measurement: method + kg/%/score/L with device and conditions
protocols.limitations: Optional for ordinary pooling; do not require weight-loss data or infer medical status.

protocols.name: Session health-change check
protocols.limitations: Separate required check from optional wellness. Exact triage prompts need clinical review.

protocols.name: Session wellness
protocols.measurement: each 1–7 with confirmed flag and scale direction
protocols.limitations: Optional in R1; skipped is not failed health screening; untouched defaults unavailable.

protocols.name: Functional access and skill review
protocols.sourcePath: proposed coach observation + client access needs
protocols.measurement: task + support + assistance + environment + demonstrated prerequisite
protocols.limitations: An experience label is not evidence of skill; disability is not a blanket contraindication.

protocols.name: Clinician handoff
protocols.measurement: verified author, scope, restrictions, permitted tasks/dose, review trigger, received/effective dates
protocols.limitations: An upload or expiration is not resolution. Sharing permission and clinical authority differ.

policies.name: Unknown adult status
policies.trigger: adult status absent, ambiguous or under 18
policies.action: No adult-module assignment until verified; minors outside R1.
policies.scope: procedural proposal; clinical classification/triage criteria require separate qualified review

policies.name: Required source not usable
policies.trigger: required source missing/stale/conflict/unavailable
policies.action: Block affected action/module; explain exact source, not all optional sources.
policies.scope: procedural proposal; clinical classification/triage criteria require separate qualified review

policies.name: Health change check
policies.trigger: per-session required check missing, unsure or changed
policies.action: No start/resume until the reviewed pathway resolves required review; draft save remains available.
policies.scope: procedural proposal; clinical classification/triage criteria require separate qualified review

policies.name: Active restriction
policies.trigger: candidate demand intersects applicable prohibited activity
policies.action: No coach pin or rank score overrides it; only authorized scoped restriction revision can resolve.
policies.scope: procedural proposal; clinical classification/triage criteria require separate qualified review

policies.name: New concerning report
policies.trigger: new pain, symptom, injury or health change requires review under adopted policy
policies.action: Preserve actuals; pause affected future execution and route to appropriate reviewer; no automated diagnosis.
policies.scope: procedural proposal; clinical classification/triage criteria require separate qualified review

policies.name: Individual scope
policies.trigger: clinical instructions missing/ambiguous or module outside reviewed clinical scope
policies.action: Do not generate condition-specific rehabilitation; request a scoped clinician handoff.
policies.scope: procedural proposal; clinical classification/triage criteria require separate qualified review

policies.name: Content admission
policies.trigger: candidate or dependency lacks approved metadata, source rights or scoped review
policies.action: Only a published accepted revision manifest can enter live pooling.
policies.scope: procedural proposal; clinical classification/triage criteria require separate qualified review

policies.name: Equipment
policies.trigger: required equipment/support/access not explicitly available and fitted
policies.action: Setting label or a similarly named item is insufficient.
policies.scope: procedural proposal; clinical classification/triage criteria require separate qualified review

policies.name: Prerequisite
policies.trigger: required task skill, position tolerance or support unconfirmed
policies.action: Training level alone cannot prove the prerequisite.
policies.scope: procedural proposal; clinical classification/triage criteria require separate qualified review

policies.name: Explicit refusal
policies.trigger: client confirmed hard refusal applies to this variant/task
policies.action: Do not relabel a refusal as low preference; discuss alternatives.
policies.scope: procedural proposal; clinical classification/triage criteria require separate qualified review

policies.name: Dose basis
policies.trigger: load/range/effort source missing or incompatible with variant/side/date
policies.action: Leave affected dose unresolved; no library percentage or cross-lift conversion.
policies.scope: procedural proposal; clinical classification/triage criteria require separate qualified review

policies.name: Time budget
policies.trigger: required content with all work/rest/setup/side/transfer time exceeds budget
policies.action: Omit optional work, try compatible alternatives, then show required gap; no silent truncation.
policies.scope: procedural proposal; clinical classification/triage criteria require separate qualified review

policies.name: Approval freshness
policies.trigger: context/catalogue/prescription generation differs from approved revision
policies.action: Invalidate affected future authority, retain immutable history and ask coach to review.
policies.scope: procedural proposal; clinical classification/triage criteria require separate qualified review

policies.name: Server availability
policies.trigger: required authoritative validation unavailable
policies.action: No assignment/start/resume; label local draft or pending actuals accurately.
policies.scope: procedural proposal; clinical classification/triage criteria require separate qualified review

policies.name: Accommodation
policies.trigger: individual support/assistance/access requirement not satisfied
policies.action: Resolve the specific requirement; do not exclude on disability label.
policies.scope: procedural proposal; clinical classification/triage criteria require separate qualified review

policies.name: Side semantics
policies.trigger: observation side, target side or dose per-side basis ambiguous
policies.action: Ask coach to specify; bilateral is not an automatic substitute for unilateral.
policies.scope: procedural proposal; clinical classification/triage criteria require separate qualified review

policies.name: Consent and purpose
policies.trigger: required lawful processing authority/evidence missing or withdrawn for affected purpose
policies.action: Suspend affected processing, preserve applicable rights/support access; optional sharing is separate.
policies.scope: procedural proposal; clinical classification/triage criteria require separate qualified review

policies.name: Instrument rights
policies.trigger: screening instrument version/use permission unverified
policies.action: Do not publish or embed questionnaire; use only a separately reviewed lawful workflow.
policies.scope: procedural proposal; clinical classification/triage criteria require separate qualified review

policies.name: Immediate stop action
policies.trigger: client requests to stop or reports concern during session
policies.action: Allow stop/report even when other operations fail; do not imply live monitoring or clinical response.
policies.scope: procedural proposal; clinical classification/triage criteria require separate qualified review

policies.name: Optional wellness
policies.trigger: wellness declined/missing/default or simulated wearable value
policies.action: No automatic R1 dose adjustment; keep required health check independent.
policies.scope: procedural proposal; clinical classification/triage criteria require separate qualified review

doses.name: General preparation
doses.selection: Coach selects duration, modality, pace/resistance and transition; 3 minutes is an arithmetic fixture, not a universal prescription.
doses.limits: No fixed heart-rate threshold or symptom clearance.
doses.valueStatus: coach-selected-before-use; illustrative numbers are synthetic arithmetic only

doses.name: General resistance
doses.selection: Coach selects sets, repetitions, effort and load after task review; fixture: 2 sets × 8 reps at 3 seconds/rep, 60 seconds between sets.
doses.limits: No automatic failure training or mapping from experience label to dose.
doses.valueStatus: coach-selected-before-use; illustrative numbers are synthetic arithmetic only

doses.name: Strength-focused resistance
doses.selection: Coach selects current same-variant load basis, sets, reps, rest and technique; fixture: 3 × 5 at 4 seconds/rep with 120-second inter-set rest.
doses.limits: Library relPct/relTo is not an accepted basis; no tested max assumed.
doses.valueStatus: coach-selected-before-use; illustrative numbers are synthetic arithmetic only

doses.name: Task/control practice
doses.selection: Coach chooses range, support, side and controlled repetitions; fixture: 1 × 6 per side at 5 seconds/rep.
doses.valueStatus: coach-selected-before-use; illustrative numbers are synthetic arithmetic only

doses.name: Conditioning
doses.selection: Coach chooses mode, work duration, intensity and breaks; fixture: 300 seconds continuous plus 30 seconds setup.
doses.limits: No automated interval prescription or wellness multiplier in R1.
doses.valueStatus: coach-selected-before-use; illustrative numbers are synthetic arithmetic only

doses.name: Optional sustained stretch
doses.selection: Coach chooses site, side, position, hold duration, repetitions and intensity; no universal corrective dose.
doses.limits: Optional; observed posture does not prove tissue shortness.
doses.valueStatus: coach-selected-before-use; illustrative numbers are synthetic arithmetic only

doses.name: Carry
doses.selection: Coach selects distance or time, side, load, route and recovery; distance additionally requires an explicit speed estimate for time planning.
doses.limits: Do not mix metres, seconds and repetitions; no automatic bilateral substitution.
doses.valueStatus: coach-selected-before-use; illustrative numbers are synthetic arithmetic only

doses.name: Optional SMR
doses.selection: Coach selects reviewed site, side, tool, pressure, exposure and transitions; duration remains unresolved until confirmed.
doses.limits: Does not diagnose or treat a tissue disorder; no neck or condition-specific protocol in this subset.
doses.valueStatus: coach-selected-before-use; illustrative numbers are synthetic arithmetic only

doses.name: Recovery pause
doses.selection: Coach chooses supported position and time for a normal unforced recovery pause.
doses.limits: Not treatment or reassurance for concerning symptoms.
doses.valueStatus: coach-selected-before-use; illustrative numbers are synthetic arithmetic only

doses.name: Clinician-defined task
doses.selection: Transcribe the specifically authorized dose/range/support and review trigger with source evidence; no generic condition defaults.
doses.limits: Workflow placeholder only: no exercise dependency admits this clinical module.
doses.valueStatus: coach-selected-before-use; illustrative numbers are synthetic arithmetic only

goals.name: General fitness
goals.limits: Coach confirms task balance and realistic schedule; no promise of health outcomes.
goals.priority: client preference plus coach-approved order; never inferred from array order
goals.weeklyStructure: Coach chooses days, split, rest and session purpose explicitly; R1 generates only one selected session, not a whole week.

goals.name: Strength
goals.limits: Use demonstrated task skill and current load basis; no automatic maximum testing.
goals.priority: client preference plus coach-approved order; never inferred from array order
goals.weeklyStructure: Coach chooses days, split, rest and session purpose explicitly; R1 generates only one selected session, not a whole week.

goals.name: Muscle development
goals.limits: Coach chooses weekly distribution and volume; no fixed volume inherited from a label.
goals.priority: client preference plus coach-approved order; never inferred from array order
goals.weeklyStructure: Coach chooses days, split, rest and session purpose explicitly; R1 generates only one selected session, not a whole week.

goals.name: Conditioning
goals.limits: Coach chooses accessible modality, intensity and progression outside R1 automation.
goals.priority: client preference plus coach-approved order; never inferred from array order
goals.weeklyStructure: Coach chooses days, split, rest and session purpose explicitly; R1 generates only one selected session, not a whole week.

goals.name: Mobility and control
goals.limits: Only confirmed task needs; assessment findings are not mandatory stretching or SMR.
goals.priority: client preference plus coach-approved order; never inferred from array order
goals.weeklyStructure: Coach chooses days, split, rest and session purpose explicitly; R1 generates only one selected session, not a whole week.

goals.name: Body-composition support
goals.limits: Support agreed activity goals; no spot-reduction or guaranteed weight-loss claim; body composition optional.
goals.priority: client preference plus coach-approved order; never inferred from array order
goals.weeklyStructure: Coach chooses days, split, rest and session purpose explicitly; R1 generates only one selected session, not a whole week.

goals.name: Clinician-defined return-to-function
goals.limits: Unsupported as an automated clinical prescription until a specifically reviewed module and individual handoff exist.
goals.priority: client preference plus coach-approved order; never inferred from array order
goals.weeklyStructure: Coach chooses days, split, rest and session purpose explicitly; R1 generates only one selected session, not a whole week.

sessions.name: Full-body resistance plus preparation
sessions.composition: Choose one eligible option for each coach-required pattern; optional patterns are coach-marked. Do not silently omit a required pull in an equipment-free setting.
sessions.budgetRule: Choice is an upper limit, not a promise to fill it. Sum explicit dose, inter-set/block rest, setup, side and transfer time; show unused time and unresolved estimates.
sessions.optionalSmr: off unless coach selects reviewed need and candidate; ordering is a proposal that the coach may revise with revalidation.

sessions.name: Travel constrained full-body
sessions.composition: Inventory precedes template. No safe anchor/no pulling option returns a gap or coach-changed session purpose, never an improvised anchor.

sessions.optionalSmr: off unless coach selects reviewed need and candidate; ordering is a proposal that the coach may revise with revalidation.
